authorization: Third independent stage of current chat's authorized architecture study; all seed0, no multi-seed confirmation, tests sealed.
question: Do persistent public grouping/global and MIB-shape tokens improve drafts beyond adding the same token network without actual membership?
architecture: Original E64 width96 depth12 rectangle trunk. Each layer has24-wide persistent grouping/global tokens,4-head coarse self-attention and FFN, plus independent MIB shape-state update. Original direct module interactions retained. No E65 messages or E66 residual decoder.
paired_difference: group_tokens pools/broadcasts true public memberships; global_tokens replaces only new-branch incidence by a uniform mixture over all eligible modules, preserving flags and active-token counts. Parameters, initialization, tensor shapes and original trunk group/MIB matrices are identical.
group_slots: First valid module per positive public group is a token slot; no numeric group-ID embedding or free reference geometry. Group-ID renaming preserves assignment structure. Slots are padded up to public120 nodes.
MIB_boundary: MIB token input contains only current variable or public fixed log aspect ratio and public area; no centers, grouping/global state or forced position equality. Hidden broadcast can indirectly influence positions but no MIB position attraction is imposed.
neutral_initialization: New group/global and MIB output projections zero; original trunk parameters and post-initialization RNG preserved with fork_rng, so initial forward equals E64 exactly.
data: Frozen v5 train16000, original logical order and train/dev_monitor500, no new cache or members, no augmentation
loss: Byte-identical E64.frozen_E42_G.v1 at final output; no token/group auxiliary losses, no ramp, no occupancy selector
selection: Same fixed dev500 G for unique best, four-tier LR and early-stop, unchanged E64 thresholds
assessment: Unique best raw dev2000, unchanged flash dev500 and same100 unscored reference/current/E42 images. Compare fixed train/dev and common update steps; record parameter count, compute and time.
interpretation: The original trunk retains public group relations in both arms; control removes grouping only from new branch, not from entire network. Global-control token count still reveals group counts. One seed on adaptive dev; no user visual acceptance or automatic baseline promotion.
gate: Promising numeric candidate: dev500 G at least0.5% below E64, full dev2000 improves, raw overlap mean not more than2% worse, healthy early-stop. No seed1 or hyperparameter sweep.
